customers_say: Customers find the water purification unit to be of good quality and reliable, with one mentioning it provides 60% higher water recovery. Moreover, they appreciate its budget-friendly nature, good installation process, and pleasant water taste. However, several customers strongly advise against purchasing this product.

reviews.author: Shashank Sharma
reviews.title: Value for money, solid build and less waste water!
reviews.body: Very nice product. Build quality is solid, the quality of tap etc is good and the main thing which I liked is that this RO actually saves water. I have seen ROs which waste more water than they purify however for this one, it throws out the same quantity of water as it filters out (I emptied the tank and then mesaured the waste water till the tank was full). It also comes with a free TDS meter which helps with peace of mind that the TDS is below the safe limit. Overall value for money and recommended for everyone.

reviews.author: Rajasekhar Reddy
reviews.title: Compact, Stylish, and Great Quality.
reviews.body: Good product with clean, healthy water. Compact design, nice appearance, and the stainless steel tank

reviews.author: FT NEJAD
reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Product and Outstanding Installation Service!
reviews.body: I am very happy with my Aquaguard water purifier. The installation service was excellent and everything was done perfectly. The installation technician was very polite, friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. He explained everything clearly and completed the installation neatly and efficiently. I am very satisfied with the overall service. Special thanks to the installation technician for his excellent work and customer-friendly attitude. Highly recommended! Excellent installation service and a great overall experience.

reviews.author: Vishal D
reviews.title: Good Product but....
reviews.body: Good product but service needs multiple follow ups.... Inlet TDS is 80 and default outlet TDS level is 10!!! The necessary TDS /Taste controller needs to be purchased separately for 300rs. More ! All the fittings are non standard forcing you to purchase an additional valve of 300Rs. The Eureka Forbes Customer care will call you 100 times for feedback/various reasons. Let's see how this holds up in the long term.

reviews.author: sagar
reviews.title: Best purifier with worst service technician with misbehaving attitude.
reviews.body: Good product and i had purchased it a year ago. It's very good product with minimum noise and do it's work perfectly. But service is worst. For complimentary service maintenance technician come without any notice and call to service and he do nothing just clean sand filter and boxup and misbehaving. The worst service ever.
